content: Screening for neuropathy in youth with type 1 diabetes should begin annually at the onset of puberty or at the age of 10 years, whichever occurs earlier, provided the individual has had type 1 diabetes for at least five years. The screening process should include a thorough assessment of symptoms, a detailed inspection of the feet, and testing for vibration sensitivity and reflexes. These evaluations should be conducted using tools such as a monofilament or a tuning fork.
